group_manifest.proof_strategy: Prove the five general len obligations in manual order. Open xizi_dll to initialize done=nil and todo=nodes. For each loop step, unfold the nonempty suffix xizi_dllseg, fold the two fields into xizi_dll_links, move the current node into the prefix with a segment-snoc argument, and retain the remaining segment. For the general transition, derive Zlength(before)+2 < 2^32 from the disjoint aligned pointer stores via store_ptr_align4, store_align4_merge, and store_align4_n_valid, then rewrite unsigned_last_nbits with that bound; the first transition has counter 0 and needs only the trivial 0<=1<2^32 bound. On exit, equal-boundary xizi_dllseg forces todo=nil and the predecessor endpoint equality; append the last processed node and use xizi_dll_close, while the zero-iteration branch folds the empty circular node. Keep all reusable facts local to witness proof bodies unless a group-local case_lib declaration is truly necessary. Do not use any forbidden lemma, in particular derivable1_refl or logic_equiv_sepcon_comm; use structured predicate unfold/fold, Intros/Exists, sep_apply, cancellation, and entailer instead.

group_entry.grouping_reason: These witnesses are the initialization, two transition shapes, and two exit shapes of the same xizi_double_link_len invariant. They share the same DLL predicates, segment endpoint facts, length equations, and local proof vocabulary; keeping them together lets one worker carry one coherent invariant proof route. The group has 5 witnesses, below the controller maximum of 12.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_len_entail_wit: Unfold xizi_dll and instantiate first,last,done=nil,todo=nodes; the second disjunct is the already-open xizi_dllseg form with todo=nodes.
Unfold the nonempty todo suffix at next_2, advance the prefix through tmp_node, instantiate done'=done_2++[next_2] and todo'=rest, and derive the 32-bit no-wrap bound from owned aligned stores.
Use done_2=nil and tmp_node=linklist_pre, unfold the first nonempty suffix node, and instantiate before=nil, done=[first_2], todo=rest; unsigned(0+1)=1 follows from the trivial range bound.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_len_return_wit: Substitute next=linklist_pre, use the equal-boundary segment to obtain todo=nil and endpoint equality, append tmp_node to before, fold links, and close xizi_dll.
Substitute first=tmp_node=linklist_pre, use the equal-boundary segment to obtain todo=nil and the predecessor equality, derive nodes=nil and linklist_length=0, then fold the empty xizi_dll.
